info.title: Tokenized Pre-IPO Trading Platform
info.description: Simulated trading of fictional pre-IPO share tokens against a USD stablecoin. All monetary values are decimal strings: cash 8dp, shares 6dp, prices 2dp.

post.summary: Register a user (credited with INITIAL_USER_FUNDING USD stablecoin) and return a JWT
Exchange email/password for a JWT bearer token

get.summary: List assets with their latest simulated price and trading status
Asset details, current price, price history and recent circuit-breaker events

post.summary: Indicative USD -> shares conversion (read-only, never creates orders)

usdAmount.description: USD amount, > 0, at most 8 decimals (decimal string, e.g. "1000")

post.summary: Place a MARKET or LIMIT order (requires Idempotency-Key)
post.description: MARKET orders are immediate-or-cancel against simulated liquidity. LIMIT orders execute what is immediately eligible and rest the remainder with funds/shares reserved. Replaying an Idempotency-Key with the same payload returns the original response with header Idempotent-Replayed: true; with a different payload returns 409.

quantity.description: Share quantity, > 0, at most 6 decimals (decimal string, e.g. "2.5")

limitPrice.description: Required for LIMIT, forbidden for MARKET; at most 2 decimals (decimal string, e.g. "400.00")

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Required. 1-255 printable ASCII chars, scoped per user

get.summary: Get one of the caller's orders with its fills

delete.summary: Cancel the open remainder of an order and release its reservation
delete.description: Allowed while a circuit breaker is active. Prior fills are preserved.

get.summary: Current balances, reservations, positions, cost basis and P&L
Portfolio reconstructed from the immutable ledger and historical prices at `at`

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Inclusive cutoff, ISO-8601 with timezone, not in the future
